context: User requested continuing after expectation approval. Implement and verify C1-C5 offline; C6 remains gated by a separate new exact budget authorization.
decision: Use one source-bound campaign request and exact outer authorization covering ordered reviewed cases, model, rubric and global limits. Debit before dispatch; stop first technical failure; reject retries/resume. Reuse existing local supervisor without adding an agent framework or migrating historical approval.

limitations: No real provider invocations, output judgments, model qualification or compilation authorization.
Development is exposed, not independent holdout. Existing approval covers expectations only.
Process containment is not a hostile-code sandbox or hard real-time guarantee; no authenticated remote model identity.
KeyboardInterrupt can lack a transport receipt; preserve unknown cleanup observations without fabricating success. Host kill or disk failure can leave incomplete consumed journals.
Campaign request a64cb6e7 still requires new exact human execution authorization. AHC-021/022 and sprint remain unfinished.
review_note: Review explicit global invariants, provenance, failure preservation and separation of expectations/execution/output approval. Active engineering reference does not approve the pending budget or model.
summary: Add opt-in development campaign with one global deadline, at most 16 charged invocations, source recheck per worker, immutable claims and offline replay; reuse existing v4 flow and process supervision. Preserve earlier compatibility replay in its original frozen package.
